efile.text: Quarterly contribution reports must be filed over the Internet once a wage schedule lists 50 or more employees in a quarter; $1 million or more in taxable wages in the current or preceding calendar year; or a payroll agent reports on behalf of an employer.

returns.name: Form TQ01C, Alaska Quarterly Contribution Report and wage schedule
contents: Due the last day of the month after the quarter: April 30, July 31, October 31, January 31; a weekend or holiday date moves to the next business day.
A report must be filed even if no wages are paid for the quarter; the report and wage schedule are due the last day of the month after the quarter, or within 10 days after the business ceases.
Contributions by employers AND employees become due as liabilities accrue: the form shows an employer rate and an employee rate (the 2026 employee rate is 0.50%).
Reports are filed online (labor.alaska.gov/estax) and online filing is mandatory for 50 or more employees, $1 million or more in taxable wages, or when a payroll agent reports for the employer.

notModelled: The employee contribution (AK_UC_EE) is reported on the same form; the engine emits it as a separate employee line and this section does not total it.
The 2026 employer rate is an input from the Department's rate notice (range 1.0% to 5.4% per its 2026 rates page).
The wage schedule file layout and the Department's online-filing specification were not read.
The report is also required of employers ceasing business within 10 days.
